A.title: RiddleVerse: Puzzle & AI Games
A.short_description: Train your brain with 70+ puzzle types, or describe a game and let AI build it.
A.full_description:
Train your brain with 70+ puzzle types - or describe any game and let AI build it for you.
Start with a quick daily puzzle, then try something new: math, logic, memory, word and visual challenges, all in one app.

CREATE A GAME FROM A SENTENCE
Type what you want ("a space shooter where you dodge asteroids and collect power-ups") and RiddleVerse's AI builds a playable game in a couple of minutes. Play it right away, share it, and see how it scores on its leaderboard.

70+ PUZZLE TYPES
- Math: equations, estimation, averages, tip calculation and more
- English and words: anagrams, crosswords, word search and synonyms
- Memory: pattern recall, memory squares, image vortex
- Visual: spot the pattern, copy the grid, find hidden objects
- Logic: Sudoku, number sequences, deduction
- Quick general knowledge questions
Every puzzle shows your score, speed bonus and progress, with difficulty levels from easy upward.

EASY TO START, HARD TO PUT DOWN
- Play as a guest - no sign-up needed to try it
- Daily reward and streak bonuses for coming back
- Leaderboards to compare your scores
- Browse and play games made by the community
- 40+ puzzle types work offline

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
RiddleVerse is free to play with ads. The free plan includes 10 AI game creations per day (100 per month). Premium removes ads and lifts those limits: $5.99 per month or $24.99 per year (prices may vary by country). Cancel anytime in Google Play.

Download RiddleVerse and give your brain a daily workout.

B.title: RiddleVerse: Build AI Games
B.short_description: Type an idea. AI builds a playable game in minutes. Plus 70+ brain puzzles.
B.full_description:
Type an idea. AI builds the game. You play it in minutes.
RiddleVerse turns a sentence into a playable game - then keeps you busy with 70+ brain puzzles when you want a challenge.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Describe a game: "a memory game with animals", "a space shooter", "a word-warp puzzle"
2. Watch it get built (about two minutes)
3. Play it, tweak it, and see how you rank on its leaderboard

Not sure what to make? Tap one of the idea chips (Space Escape, Maze Runner, Word Warp, Tilt Tunnel...) and go.

WHEN YOU WANT A CLASSIC PUZZLE
- Sudoku, number sequences and logic deduction
- Math puzzles, estimation and quick mental arithmetic
- Memory games and pattern copying
- Anagrams, word search and crosswords
- Visual challenges and hidden objects
Each one tracks your score, time and speed bonus, so you can beat your own record.

KEEP IT FUN EVERY DAY
- Open a daily gift for coins, and build a streak for bonus rewards
- Play as a guest first, sign in later if you like
- Browse games other players made and climb their leaderboards
- Works offline for 40+ puzzle types
- Also available as a Telegram bot (@Riddleverse_bot) for group-chat quizzes

OPTIONAL PREMIUM

C.full_description:
70+ puzzle types, community-made games, leaderboards and daily rewards - in one free app.
RiddleVerse is a puzzle and game hub: classic brain training plus games built by AI and by other players.

WHAT YOU GET
- 70+ puzzle types across 6 categories: Math, English, Memory, Visual, Logic and General
- AI game creator: describe a game in plain text and get a playable game in a couple of minutes
- Community games: browse new releases and trending games, play them and post scores
- Leaderboards for puzzles and games
- Daily reward with streak bonuses (bigger bonuses at 7, 14, 30, 50 and 100 days)
- Score, speed bonus and difficulty levels on every puzzle
- Guest mode: start playing without an account
- Offline play for 40+ puzzle types
- Telegram bot (@Riddleverse_bot) to quiz your group chat

PUZZLE CATEGORIES
Math (13 types), English (14), Memory (11), Visual (6), Logic (16) and General knowledge. Highlights include Sudoku, Symmetry, anagrams, crosswords, number sequences, estimation, memory squares and hidden-object searches.

BUILD YOUR OWN
Pick an idea chip or write your own prompt, and RiddleVerse's AI generates the game files for you. Edit it later with a text request, or remix a game you like. Creating uses free daily credits; some edits cost in-app coins.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
